usedFor: RealMail sends transactional email, and “Validate Email” checks an address and its deliverability.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Validate Email” in RealMail
bestTemplate.why: Each new order has its email checked, so confirmations are not wasted on bad addresses.

watchOut: “Validate Email” in RealMail needs an email address from an earlier step.
